patch_description: When two-switch descent reaches a local optimum, try a small, targeted set of three-link rotations before restarting. Rotations preserve every node’s in- and out-degree. The triples are centered on links with the highest dual prices or loads, and `tools.energy` screens the resulting networks so only a bounded number are sent to the LP. This spends LP calls on compound moves at the point they are most useful, rather than widening every two-switch neighborhood.
